user.title: Google Family Link
user.description: בחר כיצד להתחבר לשירות Family Link Auth.

manual_url.title: כתובת שרת האימות
manual_url.description:
No local authentication source was detected. Please enter the URL of your Family Link Auth container.

Example: `http://192.168.1.100:8099` or `http://familylink-auth:8099`

Enter the service token in the separate field below - do not append `?api_key=` to the URL. A pasted legacy URL that still contains it is migrated automatically.

data_description.api_token: The token from the auth container's data/api_key file, or the value of its API_TOKEN environment variable. It is sent as an X-API-Key header - never append it to the URL.

data_description.enable_location_tracking: כאשר מופעל, כל סריקת מיקום עשויה לשלוח התראה למכשיר הילד. מושבת כברירת מחדל מטעמי פרטיות.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Google Family Link
reauth_confirm.description:
The stored Google session has expired. Sign in again in the Family Link Auth add-on (or the standalone container's web UI), then submit this form.

Only fill in the token if it has changed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to authentication server. Please verify the URL and ensure the container is running.
error.invalid_auth: No cookies found. Please authenticate first using the Family Link Auth add-on or container.
error.no_cookies: Server is reachable but no cookies found. Please authenticate first via the web interface.
error.invalid_api_key: The auth service rejected the token. Copy it from the container's data/api_key file (or its API_TOKEN variable) into the token field. It must not be part of the URL.
error.session_expired: The stored Google session has expired and was deleted. Sign in again through the Family Link Auth add-on or container, then retry.
